values.note: Jones County: electric (30-amp, sites 54-66) $24 a night; semi-modern (50-amp + water, 19-25) $28; modern (30-amp, water, sewer, 1-18) $33; primitive (26-53, tent or wheeled unit) $17; an extra tent on a primitive site $4. Undated; the same pages read 2026-10-15 showed $22/$25/$30, so these are probably the 2027 prices. Read 2026-11-03.

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Jones/Park/Central-Park/ ('Modern Sites: $33 per night (30 Amp electrical hook-up, sewer, water and wifi) Sites #1-18', 'Semi-Modern Sites: $28 per night (50 Amp electrical hook-up, water and wifi) Sites #19-25', 'Electrical Sites: $24 per night (30 Amp electrical hook-up) Sites #54-66', 'Primitive Sites: $17 per night (Sites #26-53)') + https://www.jonescountyiowa.gov/conservation/parks/central_park/ (same four prices; 'One additional tent may be placed on a registered primitive campsite for a fee of $4'), read 2026-11-03

hookups.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Jones/Park/Central-Park/ (modern sites '30 Amp electrical hook-up, sewer, water'; semi-modern '50 Amp electrical hook-up, water'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: The fee table classes sites 1-66: 18 modern (1-18), 7 semi-modern (19-25), 13 electric (54-66) and 28 primitive (26-53). The 2022 campground map numbers sites up to 74 (67-74 unclassed), with gravel pads on the modern and semi-modern loops. Sites 1-25 require a wheeled camping unit; tents or wheeled units on the rest.

sites.source: https://www.jonescountyiowa.gov/conservation/parks/central_park/ ('Sites #1-18 are Modern and Sites #19-25 are Semi Modern) (Sites #54-66 are electric) (Sites #26-53 are primitive)'; 'Sites that include two or three utility services per site (Sites #1-25) are required to have a wheeled camping unit set up on site. A tent or wheeled camping unit is permitted on all other sites.') + campground map PDF (April 2022), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Wi-Fi in the modern camping area April 15 - October 15. Firewood from the camp host. Swimming beach (Memorial Day - Labor Day, free) and paddleboat/kayak rentals.

facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Jones/Park/Central-Park/ (features 'Dump station', 'Shower facilities', 'Wi-Fi') + https://www.jonescountyiowa.gov/conservation/parks/central_park/ ('Central Park now has WIFI available in the modern camping area from April 15 through October 15'; 'Firewood is available for purchase by visiting the Camp Host'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Water and electric April 15 - October 15 (weather dependent); primitive camping is available year-round.

season.source: https://www.jonescountyiowa.gov/conservation/parks/central_park/ ('The park closes for camping on October 15 and reopens on April 15 (weather permitting) each year.'; 'Water and electricity are turned on from April 15 through October 15 — weather dependent. Primitive camping is available year-round.'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Pick an open site and register at the campground kiosk within one hour (slip and payment in the box). Site availability is posted online Thursday-Sunday in season. After 14 consecutive days a camper must vacate the site for 48 hours. Check-out 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.jonescountyiowa.gov/conservation/parks/central_park/ ('We do not take reservations for our campsites. Campers simply register at the campground kiosk centers upon arrival.'; 'You must register at the information kiosks located in the camping areas within one hour of set up'; 'The maximum length of consecutive days at one site allowed is 14 days. Campers are then required to vacate that campsite for a minimum of 48 hours.') + https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Jones/Park/Central-Park/ ('Camping is a first come first serve basis - no reservations'), read 2026-11-03

note: Jones County Conservation park with a 25-acre lake and a 7-acre pond. The modern loop (sites 1-25) sits in the woods south of the park road, behind the beach, shelter and lakeside lawn; the electric and primitive sites are on the western loop. Two rental cabins overlook the lake. --Claude
summary: Fees $22-30 -> $24-33 (electric $24, semi-modern 50-amp $28, modern full hookup $33; primitive $17; undated, probably the 2027 prices, the 2026-10-15 read still showed the old ones). Confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer, showers/dump/Wi-Fi, first-come with kiosk registration; added 14-night max and season Apr 15 - Oct 15 (primitive year-round). Site count 73 left as recorded (fee table classes 66; map numbers to 74). Not waterfront confirmed: the modern loop is ~120-180 m from the lake behind the park road, beach and lawn; the electric sites 62-67 are ~50-90 m from a lake arm through woods. Pin is in the modern loop (fine).
flags: Booking wording conflict on the county's own page: the intro says 'Modern, Semi Modern, Electric and Primitive camping sites are reservable' and 'camping available on line', but its FAQ says 'We do not take reservations for our campsites' and mycountyparks says 'first come first serve basis - no reservations' (only cabins and shelters are bookable there). Recorded as first-come.
Fees rose since the 2026-10-15 read ($22/$25/$30 then; $24/$28/$33 now) with no year on the page.
